$comment: Semantic role vocabulary for Form Schema Spec 1.0 (README §8). Additions are non-breaking.

roles.customer.name: Name of the customer (person or company)
roles.asset.serial: Serial number of the serviced asset
roles.document.date: Date of the document (service, delivery or invoice date)
roles.line_item.unit: Unit of a line item (h, pcs, m)
roles.line_item.unit_price: Net unit price of a line item
roles.line_item.tax_rate: Tax rate of a line item in percent
roles.line_item.total: Net total of a line item
